## Problem

What reader, Skill author, Agent, or maintainer need is currently unmet?

## Constraints

Which Oi design principle, compatibility rule, or repository boundary must remain true?

## Smallest useful change

Describe the narrowest proposal that would make the problem reviewable. Include a short example when syntax or wording is involved.

## Alternatives considered

What other approaches did you consider, and why are they less suitable?

## Scope

Would this change touch only the repository facade, or does it require implementation work in the dedicated development worktree?
